facts.fact: WURI-Niger and the DGECM-R launched on 15 April 2025 a pilot in four communes with single civil-status counters (Dogondoutchi, Fillingue, Magaria, Tessaoua) to register unregistered under-5s and digitise birth acts held in town hall archives.

NER.note: No count or share of people holding a national ID is given; the 4 million figure is children targeted.

facts.fact: The Ministry of the Interior says the pilot launched on 15 April 2025 in four communes registers under-5s and issues them a unique identifier number with a new birth certificate, with about 4 million children targeted over three phases.
